name: LongICLBench
description: LongICLBench is a benchmark for evaluating long in-context learning capabilities of large language models on extreme-label classification tasks. It includes six datasets with large label spaces and long input sequences, assessing models' ability to comprehend entire inputs and reason over multiple pieces of information.
reputation: A specialized benchmark that has seen some use in long-context and extreme-label classification research, but it is not yet a broadly established community standard.
notes: Highlights challenges in long context understanding and reasoning for LLMs, with bias towards labels later in the sequence.
